categories.asset: Images, fonts, media, and other non-code assets.
categories.build-config: Repository, compiler, package, or build configuration.
categories.command: System commands and executable userland programs.
categories.firmware: PlatformIO projects and embedded firmware sources.
categories.node-local: Per-node runtime state or operator-owned configuration; do not ship by default.
categories.other: Files not matched by a more specific category.
categories.runtime: Boot, worker, and virtual filesystem runtime sources.
categories.sensitive: Credentials, private keys, databases, or local secrets; never package.
categories.shared-runtime: Shared runtime and filesystem support sources.
categories.system-config: Default system configuration and system package metadata.
categories.test: Tests and test-only fixtures; do not package by default.
categories.tooling: Repository maintenance, build, and development scripts.
categories.trust-anchor: Public trust material intentionally shipped with the system.

classificationStates.auto: Recognized by deterministic path, type, or source-import evidence.
classificationStates.needs-review: Ambiguous or unknown; do not package until a human override exists.
